description: Defines a template class 'stable_id_map' for managing objects with stable IDs, including iterators, insertion, deletion, and internal data structures; also defines an intrusive linked list 'stable_id_intrusive_list' for managing elements via stable IDs.

classes.name: stable_id_map
classes.description: A container managing objects with stable IDs, supporting insertion, deletion, and iteration.

classes.name: stable_id_intrusive_list
classes.description: An intrusive linked list managing elements of a stable_id_map via stable IDs.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of objects stored.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the container is empty.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an object with a given stable ID exists.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Retrieves object by stable ID (non-const and const versions).

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses object by stable ID (non-const and const versions).

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Returns internal offset of object with given ID.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts a new object, returning its stable ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an object, returning its stable ID.

methods.name: unsorted
methods.description: Returns a span of all objects.
